meta.name: api-design-assistant
meta.description: Design and review APIs with suggestions for endpoints, parameters, return types, and best practices. Use when designing new APIs from requirements, reviewing existing API designs, generating API documentation, or getting implementation guidance. Supports REST APIs with focus on endpoint structure, request/response schemas, authentication, pagination, filtering, versioning, and OpenAPI specifications. Triggers when users ask to design, review, document, or improve APIs.
